"""
{{name}} — {{description}}.

A Virgo plugin that registers tools with the plugin registry.

Usage
-----
Place in a `plugins/` directory or install with:
    virgo plugin install ./{{name}}.py

Then load with:
    virgo plugins --load
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

__plugin_meta__ = {
    "name": "{{name}}",
    "version": "{{version}}",
    "description": "{{description}}",
    "author": "{{author}}",
}


def register(registry: Any) -> None:
    """Register this plugin's tools with the tool registry.

    Parameters
    ----------
    registry : ToolRegistry
        The virgo tool registry instance. Call ``registry.register()``
        with ``Tool`` instances to make them available.
    """
    from tools import Tool

    registry.register(
        Tool(
            name="{{name}}_hello",
            fn=hello_world,
            description="A simple hello-world tool from {{name}}",
        )
    )


def hello_world(name: str = "World") -> str:
    """Return a friendly greeting."""
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

"""
Tests for the {{name}} plugin.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

from {{name}} import __plugin_meta__, hello_world, register


class TestPluginMeta:
    """Verify plugin metadata is well-formed."""

    def test_has_plugin_meta(self) -> None:
        assert "name" in __plugin_meta__
        assert "version" in __plugin_meta__
        assert "description" in __plugin_meta__
        assert "author" in __plugin_meta__

    def test_name_matches(self) -> None:
        assert __plugin_meta__["name"] == "{{name}}"

    def test_version_format(self) -> None:
        import re

        assert re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+", __plugin_meta__["version"])


class TestRegister:
    """Verify the register function works correctly."""

    def test_register_adds_tool(self) -> None:
        registry = MagicMock()
        register(registry)
        assert registry.register.called

    def test_hello_world_default(self) -> None:
        assert hello_world() == "Hello, World!"

    def test_hello_world_custom(self) -> None:
        assert hello_world(name="Virgo") == "Hello, Virgo!"
